invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieData created via HoodieListData.eager, which should not be null.
Assuming the contract of the API and method, records should not be null at exit.
The method uses context as a parameter to internal methods, thus it must be non-null at METHOD_EXIT.
The hoodieTable parameter is used in internal method calls, so it must be non-null at exit.
The return value is explicitly a HoodieData at all exits.
